tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: Three point particles of masses 1.0 kg, 1.5 kg and 2.5 kg are placed at three corners of a right angle triangle of sides 4.0 cm, 3.0 cm and 5.0 cm as shown in the figure. The centre of mass of the system is at a point:

solution.text:
Take 1 kg mass at origin

Xcm=1×0+1.5×3+2.5×05=0.9 cm
Ycm=1×0+1.5×0+2.5×45=2 cm
